{{Top}}
{{MultipleIssues|citation|expand}}
{{MoreSources}}
[[File:Wedge_Antilles.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] wearing his flight helmet]]
'''Flight helmets''' were headgear worn by [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] pilots. The helmets often included a visor with a special computer projection for targeting. The helmets of pilots of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] were often decorated with a red or blue [[Alliance Starbird]],<ref name="EG Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> though some pilots customized them to include symbols of personal significance or emblems from specific [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]]. Their craft's [[Life support/Legends|life support]] systems negated the need for a self-contained helmet such as those used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[TIE pilot]]s,<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> but such masks could be attached in emergency situations. Many of the helmet designs continued to be used into the era of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].

==Details==
[[File:RiddellXWPBP.jpg|thumb|left|150px|X-wing flight helmet blueprint]]
The Rebels' [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] flight helmets were made of a [[Plasteel/Legends|plasteel]] hull and included a [[Dysonic motivator housing]] on the ridges of the helmet and [[customized heat diffusion plating]] on the sides; [[AerTech Atmospheric Conversion Regulator/Legends|AerTech atmospheric conversion regulators]] on the edges of the helmet on the dorsal facial edges; a localized [[atmospheric field generator]] on the edge of the central ridge; a retractable [[Polarizing visor/Legends|polarizing visor]]; [[Reifflex cellular padding|Reifflex adaptable foam]] lining the inside of the helmet; a [[Sensa-mic/Legends|ComTech sensa-mic]] for reporting to mission control and issuing commands to wingmates; and a [[Flexfit Chin Pad/Legends|flexfit chin pad]] with an adjustable strap lock. The X-wing helmet was the most seen in the Alliance, and many pilots -- such as the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] pilots during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] -- wore them no matter the starfighter model. The variations were more common by the time of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

The standard Y-wing pilot helmet was equipped with an [[Identichip/Legends|identichip]], protective [[Eye/Legends|eye]] lenses, [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], flight systems input jack, and an audio receiver. The helmet was much like that of a standard [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] helmet, but with a few minor differences. The helmet itself was much more rounded and elongated, with smoother curves. Also, the chin support bar was built into the actual helmet, as opposed to the X-Wing helmet, where it was merely a strap.

[[A-wing]] pilot helmets came in two variations. One was similar to a Y-wing helmet, and the other was smaller and worn in conjunction with cloth headgear. It included a microphone that extended outward in front of the pilot's face.

[[File:Dllr_Nep_helmet.jpg|thumb|right|150px|X-wing pilot [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] variant - [[Dllr Nep]]]]
Like those of A-wing pilots, [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] pilot helmets were worn with cloth headgear underneath. The smaller wraparound helmet also included a microphone like the A-wing helmets did.

===Species variants===
The most widely used helmet designs in the Alliance were those used by [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[Near-Human]] species. To accommodate the variety of body types among the various non-human races that served as Rebel pilots, many helmets differed in configuration. Some were slight variations of the typical helmet with added openings or compartments to accommodate a race's body types, while others were vastly different.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:A-wing_helmet.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A-wing pilot variant - Tycho Celchu]]
The helmets worn by Alliance X-wing pilots were made from modified plastic copies of real [[Wikipedia:United States Navy|United States Navy]] APH-6B flight helmets.<ref name="Star Wars Magazine UK 68">[[Star Wars: The Official Magazine 68|''Star Wars: The Official Magazine'' 68]]</ref>

Many of the unique helmets used by pilots in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] were reused in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], even though many of the pilots in the first film were killed. In one example, an [[Rogues Gallery (department)|article]] in [[Star Wars Insider 146|''Star Wars Insider'' 146]] reveals that [[Nichos Panib]], a pilot seen in ''The Empire Strikes Back'', is wearing a helmet with the same design as [[Garven Dreis/Legends|Garven Dreis]]' in ''A New Hope'' to honor the deceased Dreis, an old family friend.

Some of the helmets from the original trilogy were used once again many years later in [[1995]] for the video game ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire]]'', which included live action elements and many props and costumes from the movies.

X-wing and Y-wing pilots in ''A New Hope'' used the same style of helmet, but three new designs were introduced in ''Return of the Jedi''. Two were created for the movie's new A-wing and B-wing starfighters, while the Y-wing pilots no longer wore the same helmet as X-wing pilots. The A-wing pilot extra in the ''Return of the Jedi'' briefing room scene later identified as [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] can be seen carrying a helmet similar to the new Y-wing pilots'. That helmet was given to the Celchu action figure,<ref name="Tycho figure">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|pack=#44: Tycho Celchu (A-Wing Pilot)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TAC44awing.asp}}</ref> and is referred to as an A-wing helmet in the [[Star Wars Chronicles|''Star Wars: Chronicles'']] book.
